name: north-carolina-criminal-law
description: North Carolina criminal law tools: fill AOC-CR court forms (320 forms, full process from arrest through post-conviction), look up NC Pattern Jury Instructions for Criminal Cases (N.C.P.I.—Crim., 1,100+ instructions), read full statutory text for all ~1,100 sections of G.S. Chapter 14, generate a prosecutorial summary (probable-cause screening) from a police report, and generate a defense case analysis (weaknesses in the State's case, defenses, and action items) for defense counsel.
